items.rationale: A1/A2/C1/C2/C5: Brânză is a concrete everyday food with one dominant culinary meaning. Historical dictionary and current Romanian dairy reporting support ordinary familiarity; salience 0.9238 meets easy. A3/A4: milk, named cheeses and actual cheese-filled dishes form honest recognizable relations, not invented origin claims. A5/A6: no adult premise or prior target. C3/C4: 14 incoming, 2321 reachable; Telemea 3/Urdă 4/Cașcaval 5/Lapte 7 are immediately hot. The real Mâncare 2 clue, repeat/resume and exact answer all worked. Refute-first: Sarmale 26 is warm and Butter 373 cold, so indirect dairy feedback is incomplete. These do not replace the multiple defining near guesses. Promote for its strong concrete core, without claiming complete ranking realism.

A1/A2/C1/C2/C5: Lapte is familiar concrete food vocabulary, with longstanding school-program presence and ordinary dairy reporting; salience 0.9202 meets easy. A3/A4: glass, milk products and school milk provide specific, recognizable links. The qualified freezer-variant link does not assert that all milk preparations freeze identically. A5/A6: no boundary trigger or old target. C3/C4: 14 incoming, 2321 reachable; Pahar 2, Lapte și corn 4, Brânză 5 and Smântână 7 give a clear core. Pahar 2 clue, repeat/resume and exact win were verified on real private endpoints. Refute-first: Sarmale 23 is warm, Stilou 158 lukewarm, and Biscuit 296 cold. The defined milk cues still outrank that noise by a wide margin. Promote; human enjoyment remains unmeasured.

A1/A2/C1/C2/C5: Savarină is the familiar filled cofetărie pastry, supported by a 2013 family recipe and national-TV demonstrations in 2016/2025. C6: salience 0.55 slightly misses the numeric easy threshold; its documented ordinary recognition explicitly justifies this exception without changing salience. A3/A4: the new whipped-cream filling is defining and verifiable. No alcohol-dependent guess is needed (A5), and this is a distinct target from Ecler/Amandină rather than a duplicate identity (A6). C3/C4 now have 5 recognizable incoming neighbors: Prăjitură/Amandină/Ecler 2 and Desert/Frișcă 5 are hot. Safe pastry clue, repeat/resume and exact win passed. Yeast/oven 51 remain only warm, but that incompleteness does not obscure the new filling cue and existing pastry core. Promote.

A1/A2/C1/C2/C5: Frișcă is the familiar concrete whipped topping, not an abstract preparation category. Recognizable recipe/broadcast use and the equipment producer’s clear account support easy; salience 0.85 meets the floor. A3/A4: suitable sweet cream, optional sugar/vanilla, beating and cold storage are honest; fermented sour cream is not treated as a synonym. A5/A6: no boundary trigger or previous target. C3/C4: 5 incoming and 2321 reachable; Smântână, Zahăr pudră, Vanilie, Frigider and qualified Mixer are all rank 2/hot. I identified the weaker reverse savarina cue and independently accepted its exact-pair correction: now Savarină 2/hot with original ID and no win. Frigider 2 clue, repeat/resume and exact answer passed again afterward. Sarmale 30 remains too warm and Ecler 202 lukewarm; the defining five-input core remains strong. Promote.

A1/A2/C1/C2/C5: Cremă de vanilie is a concrete familiar pastry filling; the qualifier separates it from other cream meanings. Manufacturer and established eclair recipes support recognition and the actual ingredient roles; salience 0.75 meets easy. A3/A4: milk/yolk/starch are documented variants rather than universal requirements for every cream. A5/A6: no boundary trigger or prior target. C3/C4: 5 recognizable incoming ingredients and 2321 reachable; Lapte, Zahăr, Vanilie, Gălbenuș and Amidon alimentar are all rank 2/hot. The initially cold Ecler 322 association was substantively repaired before review: exact pair Ecler→cream now rank 2/hot, retains Ecler identity and cannot win. The post-correction Lapte 2 clue, repeat/resume and exact answer pass. Butter 316/cold, Sarmale 30/warm and Stilou 173/lukewarm remain imperfections. Promote because the defining core and natural pastry opener now both work.

A1/A2/D1: Frigider and Înghețată are ordinary recognizable endpoints; long-lived recipes and current family-event reporting support the latter despite its misleading salience 0.2826. Explicitly accept the easy warning without changing it. A3/A4/D2: refrigerator→whipped cream→ice cream is storage then ingredient use; refrigerator→freezer→ice cream is a qualified component then frozen storage. Manufacturer instructions support the refrigeration/freezing distinction; ordinary fridge shelves are not claimed to freeze ice cream. A5/A6: no boundary trigger or old exact/reverse pair. D3: 2 credible first hops, 2-layer width, 2 intermediates, both visible; both real API paths win in 2 moves and resume. Premature direct target input is rejected without a move. D4/D5: a meaningful easy preparation/storage discovery, not taxonomy padding or an invented physical transformation. Promote.
